scenario: A TypeError that reaches a surface is asserted as a `TypeError` fault fact a rule can match (LERR.9.1, LERR.9.3). The program is LERR.1.3.1.a_json_leaf_of_the_wrong_type_is_a_type_error's -- `p.body.name` is a String and `>` wants a number, so the tainted arm of the funnel raises a TypeError, not an EngineError -- plus a handler. The trap is in a join test on the pattern's beta, so the fact's `rule` is `$beta_<id>` (LERR.9.11), matched by regex, with the `$` escaped, since the id is compiler-assigned. Drives the TypeError arm of the fault-fact queue and the drain at the end of the host assert's propagation (LERR.9.7). Pin: assert Payload(body={name: "alice"}); pump. Messages are ['type error at a beta']; `r` never fires.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    Payload p where p.body.name > 5
->
    log info "fired"

rule handler:
    TypeError e where e.rule ~ /^\$beta_[0-9]+$/
->
    log critical "type error at a beta"
